During the [[Desolator crisis]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] was sent on a '''mission''' to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to locate the missing [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] and to destroy the [[Power Guard Enhancement System]], which had fallen into the hands of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Working with Chief [[Rieekan (SIS)|Rieekan]] and the agents of the SIS unit on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], the Knight followed Agent Galen's trail to the [[Nikto Sector]], where the Jedi found the [[Power Guard recruitment center]] under the control of Imperial forces. Chasing Agent Galen and his captor Lord [[Sadic]], the apprentice of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], across Nar Shaddaa, the Jedi fought through Imperial forces and Power Guards to finally catch up to Sadic in the Imperial prison district of [[Shadow Town]]. During the mission, Chief Rieekan and many of his agents were massacred by Power Guards in a [[Raid on the SIS safe house|raid]] on their [[SIS safe house|safehouse]], and Agent Galen was converted into a Power Guard against his will. The Knight eventually [[Raid on Sadic's laboratory|fought]] and killed Sadic in his laboratory, and the remnants of the Power Guard project was destroyed by the SIS and the commandos of the Republic's [[Blackstar Squad]].
